description: This file defines the Addition class within the Matrix\Operators namespace, implementing addition operations for matrices and scalars, with methods for executing addition, handling different input types, and performing matrix element-wise addition.

classes.name: Addition
classes.description: A class that extends Operator to perform addition operations on matrices and scalars.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Performs addition with the provided value, handling different types like array, Matrix object, and numeric.

methods.name: addScalar
methods.description: Adds a scalar value to each element of the matrix.

methods.name: addMatrix
methods.description: Adds the values of another matrix to the current matrix, after validating dimensions.
